rows.notes: FLAG: Chariton is in Lucas County, about 50 miles south of Des Moines, so this listing is outside the Des Moines metro. The stored website (bit.ly/IronHorseGrill) redirects to ironhorseneighborhoodgrill.com, a brand site shared with the Osceola location (Iron Horse Neighborhood Grill, 123 S Main St, Osceola). The location-specific URL for this row is https://order.toasttab.com/online/the-iron-horse-charitone. 'Charitone' in the name is correct: the restaurant is in the Hotel Charitone. The menu comes from the restaurant's own Toast ordering page for the Chariton location, read from its embedded menu data (Dinner, Kids and Drinks menus). Toast stores prices as numbers, so I formatted them as dollars; prices are the restaurant's own online-ordering prices, not third-party delivery markups. A Lunch menu (a 'Burger - Lunch' item URL turned up in search) wasn't in the server-rendered data, so it isn't extracted. Toast gives the eleven kids fountain and milk drinks no price, so they're grouped in one row with price null. Typos are kept as published ('Fetal Cheese', 'ad dental', 'pilled'). A few mis-encoded characters in the source were normalized: 'sauteed', 'Sam Adam's', 'its'. The menu marks no dietary tags.
